question: The phenomenon of change of liquid into vapours at any temperature below its boiling point is called:
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Evaporation**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Evaporation** is the process in which a liquid changes into vapor (gas) at temperatures below its boiling point.
 
• This happens when molecules at the surface of the liquid gain enough energy to overcome the forces of attraction between them
